posts.title: How to read books
posts.description: A statement made on an AI training course I had to attend (I'm paraphrasing but this was the gist): " I really do believe this is how books will be consumed in the future - by the AI summarising it neatly for you ". Riiiight... and who's going to be writing these books, once no one is reading them any more?? AI??? How long after that will your models collapse in on themselves, caught in some god-a

posts.title: Google has ruined Maps
posts.description: Maps nav used to be good. But on a recent trip to Thailand, I lost count of the number of times it sent us on really stupid routes (round Bangkok via Rama III, rather than thru the centre, despite traffic being worse). I thought this was maybe due to route changes on Thai roads, but back in the UK, it keeps sending us off the motorway to carry on the motorway. Traffic doesn't explain the re-route.

posts.title: About time, but not enough
posts.description: UK announces sanctions on West Bank settlements prompting furious Israeli response This has taken far too long to happen, but frankly has not gone far enough... it should be a full trade embargo.
